method: Actual independent inspection of architect photographs and ordinary permitted private print-view pages before geometry; no automatic tracing or source-pixel reuse. Manual proportional registration, not metric photogrammetry.

features.feature: Whole unequal triangular/wedge footprint and attached rectangular service block
features.required: No generic rectangular chalet, no isolated balcony fragment, no separate count for tower.

features.feature: Complete nonuniform roof, PV band, green field and low western end
features.required: Preserve asymmetric main slope and low-end break, narrow dividing roof walk/railings, broad triangular green roof and long separate PV field; no guessed gable/pyramid or flattened slab.

features.feature: Service tower with upper louvered enclosure and solid core
features.required: Distinguish solid gray service body from taller slatted equipment-screen rim; do not fill the upper rim as a featureless solid additional storey.

features.feature: Two above-ground floors plus exposed lower level on creek side
evidence: P01 p5–6 floor statement and longitudinal section
features.required: Follow grade difference; never label the visible lower level an invented third above-ground floor. Balcony floors are open recesses, not continuous closed orange wall.

features.feature: Continuous long balcony frontage with returns, posts, deep roof eaves and end stair
features.required: Keep reading terraces as real depth/void, major perimeter turns and supporting posts. Fine railing repetition may be print-thickened without sealing whole bays.

features.feature: Different park-side and end façade patterns
evidence: A05 gray service/timber glass south side
features.required: No mirror-copy of long balcony face onto all sides; preserve high glazed end and service wall as materially different exterior regions. Use only footprint-bounded joins where foliage hides minor detail.

Warm amber/honey timber frames/soffits, darker weathered gray-brown horizontal rail/deck bands, gray textured service face with pale courses, dark muted green/blue glass, muted green roof and blue-gray PV. No source-photo textures, artwork, logos or transcribed decorative drawings.

coordinate_registration: Source plans compared by service block, wedge vertices, PV/green separation and creek edge, not page-up north. Model +X high/east end, -X low/west end, diagonal +Y creek side.
limitations: No measured as-built survey or full dimensioned working drawings; section/roof-plan raster and photos constrain proportions, not exact dimensions.

East façade foliage partially occludes lower details. Whole1F/RF, section and adjacent actual views bound major mass; reviewer must flag any still-unbounded silhouette, rather than invent a hidden bay.
Small roof objects/plant shapes differ between plan symbols and aerial; one clearly visible skylight is positively supported in A01. Do not convert every white RF symbol into an extra skylight.
Photo colors are illumination/weathering dependent, not calibrated paint codes.
Original photographic capture dates and individual photographer credits are not supplied.
major_join_checks: Full roof and lower-wall footprints are distinct
Service tower intersects body and low roof, upper screen remains open
Ground/three exterior levels align with higher park grade
North terrace and east return are geometrically open
South service and east glazed faces are not mirrored north balconies

plan_RF_section_registration.RF: Full roof right-triangle major-envelope aspect approximately 0.91 from ordinary visual plan inspection; model 170.52/188=0.907 after whole cross-axis registration. Green field starts near 0.59 of roof X span and service block spans roughly the lower western third. No source vectors or image tracing.
plan_RF_section_registration.1F: Lower wall footprint differs from roof: inset wedge, a kink near low north end, attached rectangular southern service block and open creek terraces with high-end return. Source trees and image resolution limit minor bay counts.
plan_RF_section_registration.long_section: Steeper west tail rises 12 to 44 mm across 66 model mm, then gentler high field rises 44 to 61 across 122 model mm. Three creek-visible floors at 1.4/17.4/33.4 mm; park grade 17 mm. These are source-proportion interpretation, not measured building dimensions.
plan_RF_section_registration.high_end: Tall timber/glass end joins opaque board portion, deep triangular roof overhang and localized balcony return, rather than a fourth floor.
plan_RF_section_registration.reverse_side: Gray rectangular service core with pale horizontal courses and small windows transitions into timber/glass park facade with projecting shade; upper service screen open above solid core.
plan_RF_section_registration.precision_limits: Manual major-envelope registration only; not sub-pixel photogrammetry, licensed drawing duplication or an as-built fit.

technical_geometry_note: A shared-vertex float artifact introduced by applying the RF cross-axis stretch before Boolean triangulation was eliminated by applying that same affine stretch after canonical union triangulation. Delivered stretched STL is independently reloaded and fully scanned at unchanged 1e-5 mm coordinate tolerance. Roof trim/slat clearances were authored physically; checks were not loosened.
